title_vi: I have … và I’ve got … (tôi có …)
theory_html:
A. have or have got

A. have hoặc have got

You can say I have or I’ve got, he has or he’s got:

Có thể nói I have hoặc I’ve got, he has hoặc he’s got:

havehave got (short form
dạng rút gọn)
I / we / you / theyhavehave got (I’ve got / we’ve got / you’ve got / they’ve got)
he / she / ithashas got (he’s got / she’s got / it’s got)

  • I’ve got a headache.

    Tôi bị đau đầu.

  • I have blue eyes. or I’ve got blue eyes.

    Tôi có mắt xanh.

  • Tom has two sisters. or Tom has got two sisters.

    Tom có hai chị em gái.

  • Our car has four doors. or Our car has got four doors.

    Xe của chúng tôi có bốn cửa.

  • Sarah isn’t feeling well. She has a headache. or She’s got a headache.

    Sarah thấy không khỏe. Cô ấy bị đau đầu.

  • They like animals. They have a horse, three dogs and six cats. or They’ve got a horse …

    Họ thích động vật. Họ có một con ngựa, ba con chó và sáu con mèo.

B. I don’t have / I haven’t got etc. (negative)

B. I don’t have / I haven’t got v.v. (phủ định)

don’t / doesn’t havehaven’t / hasn’t got
I / you / we / theydon’t havehaven’t got
he / she / itdoesn’t havehasn’t got

  • I don’t have a car. or I haven’t got a car.

    Tôi không có xe hơi.

  • They don’t have any children. or They haven’t got any children.

    Họ không có con.

  • It’s a nice house, but it doesn’t have a garden. or … it hasn’t got a garden.

    Ngôi nhà đẹp, nhưng nó không có vườn.

  • Amy doesn’t have a job at the moment. or Amy hasn’t got a job …

    Hiện giờ Amy không có việc làm.

C. do you have? / have you got? etc. (questions)

C. do you have? / have you got? v.v. (câu hỏi)

do/does … have?have/has … got?
I / you / we / theydo I / you / we / they have?have I / you / we / they got?
he / she / itdoes he / she / it have?has he / she / it got?

  • ‘Do you have a camera?’ ‘No, I don’t.’ or ‘Have you got a camera?’ ‘No, I haven’t.’

    ‘Bạn có máy ảnh không?’ ‘Không.’

  • ‘Does Helen have a car?’ ‘Yes, she does.’ or ‘Has Helen got a car?’ ‘Yes, she has.’

    ‘Helen có xe hơi không?’ ‘Có.’

  • What kind of car does she have? or … has she got?

    Cô ấy có loại xe gì?

  • How many children do they have? or … have they got?

    Họ có mấy đứa con?

mcq.question: I ___ blue eyes.
mcq.full: I’ve got blue eyes.
mcq.expl:
I have = I’ve got; he has = he’s got (the meaning is the same).
I have = I’ve got; he has = he’s got (nghĩa như nhau).
Điểm ngữ pháp: I have = I’ve got.
mcq.key: I ___ blue eyes.|’ve got
